generated_full_moveset.note: Full T3 bank depth, real decoded motion-bank rows. Paul Phoenix base (user pick 2026-10-23) as GYOU spirit-body variant. 372 bank rows, 170 attack rows with determinable inputs (166 from neutral stance). Phase A = Dijkstra seeded from neutral stance row 0 only (true neutral inputs; ties broken toward unconditional then bare-button inputs). Phase B = all stance hubs for rows unreachable from neutral (hub-context keys, suffixed _r<row> where they collide). No inputs invented.
